content.text:
Sentry is the default pick for a 10-person team, with Rollbar as the cheaper alternative if per-seat pricing is the problem. Bugsnag is a reasonable third option but I'd rank it last. The price data is unreliable, so confirm current numbers on each vendor's pricing page before buying.

| | **Sentry** | **Rollbar** | **Bugsnag** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free tier | Developer plan, aimed at individuals (one listing says 1 user, 5K errors/month) | Free plan with unlimited users and projects | Free tier, one listing says 50K events/month |
| Paid entry tier | Team, about $26–29/month per developer (sources disagree) | Essentials, somewhere between $7.50 and $15/month (sources disagree) | Select, $20/month (one aggregator); another source says $65/user/month |
| Top paid tier | Business, about $80–89/month | Advanced, $10.83–32/month (sources disagree) | Preferred, $33/month |
| Pricing model | Per seat plus event volume | Event-based, unlimited users | Event-based tiers, with some sources listing per-user pricing |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom, for above 80M events/month | Custom |

**How they compare for your team:**

- **Sentry** has the broadest SDK coverage and the most mature performance and tracing features, and it's the most common choice, so hiring and integrations are easy. The cost is per-seat, so 10 developers on Team tier is a real line item.
- **Rollbar** lists unlimited users on every plan, so the bill depends on event volume, not headcount. For a 10-person team that's often the cheapest option. Its feature depth relative to Sentry is something I haven't verified.
- **Bugsnag** has a clear, simple error-monitoring focus, but the sources give conflicting pricing (per-user versus per-event), and I couldn't reach its pricing page to resolve it. It's the least certain of the three.

**Recommendation:** Start with Sentry's free tier or Team trial. If you're on a tight budget or expect a lot of event volume, trial Rollbar with the same app for two weeks and compare the cost at your real event rate. I'd skip Bugsnag unless one of the others fails on a specific requirement you have.

**Caveat:** The pricing figures come from third-party aggregator sites that disagree with each other, and I didn't verify feature differences against vendor documentation. Before you decide, check the official pricing pages and, if you can, run a trial with your actual event volume.

Sources:
- [Sentry pricing (Capterra)](https://www.capterra.com/p/165426/Sentry/pricing/)
- [Sentry pricing (CostBench)](https://costbench.com/software/developer-tools/sentry/)
- [Rollbar pricing (official)](https://www.rollbar.com/pricing-for-agents)
- [Rollbar pricing (PricingSaaS)](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/rollbar)
- [Rollbar pricing (CostBench)](https://costbench.com/software/error-tracking/rollbar/)
- [Bugsnag pricing (CostBench)](https://www.costbench.com/software/error-tracking/bugsnag/)
- [Bugsnag pricing (Softwareadvice)](https://www.softwareadvice.com/application-performance-manage/bugsnag-profile/)
